ai.title: AI Message Composition
ai.enable: Use AI to write the message
ai.enableDesc: Sends the listing, your persona, and the template to an AI agent, which returns one ready-to-send message.
ai.harnessNone: No agent CLI found. Install Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI to use this provider.
ai.acpDesc: Homelander starts the harness on demand and uses its existing login — no API key is stored here.
ai.openAiDesc: Any endpoint that speaks /chat/completions — OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Mistral, Ollama, LM Studio.
ai.modelPlaceholder: Load the harness models, or type an id
ai.modelsNone: This harness offers no model list — the model is passed at startup instead.
ai.promptDesc: The exact prompt sent to the AI. The variables are filled in per listing; {{template}} is your message template below, already filled in.
ai.languageNote: The message is written in the language of the listing — German listings get a German message, English ones English.
ai.fallbackNote: If both attempts fail, Homelander sends the message template instead — applications are never skipped because of AI.

settings.pollIntervalDesc: How often to check for new listings

placeholder.template:
Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,
ich interessiere mich für {{title}} in {{address}}...

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
{{name}}

settings.supportExportDesc: Export redacted logs, config, Chrome status, and recent debug screenshots/HTML.
settings.supportBundlePath: Creates a .zip in ~/.homelander/support-bundles, opens the folder, and copies the path.
settings.cleanConfirm: This will delete all data — listings, config, API keys. Type your email to confirm.
settings.resetAppsConfirm: Removes all listings, searches, and history. Your settings and IS24 login are kept. Type your email to confirm.
settings.supportDesc: Creates a zip with daemon log, config (redacted), and recent debug screenshots.

cleanup.title: Clean up all local data
cleanup.desc: Wipe IS24 profile, debug files, and history. This does not touch your IS24 account.
cleanup.confirm: This will delete all local Homelander data.

donate.title: Support ❤️
donate.desc: Homelander is free and open source. Help keep development going.

setup.title: Setup
setup.changeLater: You can change this later in Settings
setup.searchDesc: Paste an IS24 search URL to auto-fill it after setup.
setup.personaDesc: Tell Homelander who you are — this fills IS24 contact forms.
setup.messageDesc: Customize the message sent with each application.
setup.is24Desc: Log into IS24 so Homelander can apply on your behalf.
setup.captchaDesc: 2captcha API key for automated captcha solving (optional).
setup.personaSubtext: These details will be filled into the IS24 contact form for every application.
setup.messageSubtext: This message will be sent for every application. Use {{title}}, {{address}}, and {{name}} as placeholders.
setup.is24PendingDesc: Open Chromium and log in to IS24.
setup.is24WaitingDesc: Only click Continue after IS24 shows you are logged in. Do not close or hide the Chromium window.
setup.is24PreparingDesc: Keeping this login for future applications.
setup.is24ErrorDesc: Try again after Chromium is available.
setup.captchaSubtext: IS24 sometimes shows captcha. Costs ~0.001$ to solve with a key from 2captcha.com.
setup.searchSubtext: Paste an IS24 search URL to get started. You can add more searches later from the Searches tab.
setup.searchSkip: Leave empty to skip — you can add searches later.
setup.placeholderCaptcha: Leave empty to skip captcha solving

search.title: Searches
search.markAppliedLabel: Skip exposés you've already applied to manually:
search.noSearchesHint: Add an IS24 search URL to start auto-applying to new listings.
search.enterSearchUrl: Please enter an IS24 search URL
search.name: Name
search.pasteUrl: Paste a full IS24 search URL
search.duplicateFailedTip: Homelander checks Nachrichten automatically before sending.
search.duplicateReadyHelper: Homelander checks your IS24 Nachrichten before sending.

backendUnavailable.title: Backend unavailable
backendUnavailable.message: Homelander is still starting up. Try again in a moment.

browserStartFailed.title: Could not open Chromium
browserStartFailed.message: Homelander could not start its bundled browser. Restart the app and try again.

browserNotResponding.title: Chromium is not responding
browserNotResponding.message: The controlled Chromium session stopped responding. Restart Chromium or restart Homelander.

sessionExpired.title: Login needed
sessionExpired.message: Homelander needs you to log back into IS24 before it can continue applying.

searchUrlInvalid.title: Search URL not accepted
searchUrlInvalid.message: This does not look like a usable IS24 search URL. Paste the full search results URL from IS24.

searchPollFailed.title: Could not poll this search
searchPollFailed.message: Homelander could not refresh listings for this search. IS24 or the network may be temporarily unavailable.

configSaveFailed.title: Could not save settings
configSaveFailed.message: Homelander could not save the settings. Try again or restart the app.

databaseError.title: Could not read saved data
databaseError.message: Homelander could not read or write its local database. Restart the app.

captchaKeyInvalid.title: 2captcha key not accepted
captchaKeyInvalid.message: 2captcha did not accept this key. Check the key or leave it empty.

cleanupConfirmationFailed.title: Email does not match
cleanupConfirmationFailed.message: Type the configured email exactly to confirm.

csvExportFailed.title: Could not export history
csvExportFailed.message: Homelander could not export the selected history rows.

daemonActionFailed.title: Daemon action failed
daemonActionFailed.message: Homelander could not change the daemon state. Try again or restart.

listingRetryFailed.title: Could not queue retry
listingRetryFailed.message: Homelander could not queue this listing for retry.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.message: Homelander could not complete that action. Details were logged.
